profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Results-driven Software Engineer with 4 years of experience specializing in backend systems and microservices. Adept at developing and optimizing distributed systems and microservices, with a strong foundation in object-oriented programming. Possesses excellent analytical skills honed through teaching and professional experience. Proven track record of quick learning and adaptability. Huge advocate for creating positive team culture in remote environments.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software Engineer under the FAA on a Scaled Agile feature team responsible for developing and maintaining applications using Java, Go, Oracle, and PL/SQL, as well as for developing automated tests for Jira features to enable more efficient workflows and pipelines using Github Actions workflows with Redhat OpenShift Service on AWS.  Data-driven team, focused on value delivery to customers and providing statistics to support contributed work.  Efforts towards modernizing the FAA work environment with Cloud Adoption via AWS to enable automated workflows and pipelines to better support developer workloads alongside the general safety and efficiency of the National Air Space.  Became SAFe Practitioner Certified and AWS Cloud Practitioner Certified here and continue to develop AWS knowledge as part of a culture committed to continuous learning.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software Engineer under the FAA responsible for developing and maintaining business-critical, Surface Surveillance applications/systems in Go, Java, and C++.  Focus on concurrent microservices and event-driven architectures consuming dynamically sized network messages with manual encryption and parsing to increase security and fault-tolerance of Surface Surveillance Systems.  Responsible for writing code documentation and ensuring reliable, and especially, maintainable code.

positions.title: Graduate Assistant
positions.description: Graduate Assistant responsible for teaching percussion courses, managing classrooms, teaching private lessons, and managing ensemble rehearsals.
